The global pivotal PERFORMA Phase 3 trial will test two doses of pemvidutide over an estimated duration of approximately 60 months for liver-related events supporting final approval, including an interim analysis after 52 weeks with biopsy-based endpoints to support an accelerated approval.
The 52-week data readout from the PERFORMA trial to support the accelerated approval of pemvidutide is anticipated in 2029.
On July 28, 2026, we announced the positive topline results from the RECLAIM Phase 2 trial evaluating the 2.4 mg dose of pemvidutide in patients with moderate to severe AUD.
